title: Private room 15 min to downtown Nashville
description:
Quiet neighborhood near cul-de-sac, .5 mile from mall, restaurants, and other businesses, close to interstate. Only 12-15 minutes from downtown and 20-25 minutes from international airport.

The space
One private upstairs bedroom,  1 queen bed, sleeps 2, private bath, wifi, tv, access to kitchen, living room, patio, and washer/dryer if requested.

Guest access
Guests will have access to upstairs bedroom, full bath, use of kitchen area, living room, tv, and washer and dryer upon request. Outside porch or patio may also be accessible.

During your stay
When available I can offer Uber services if my guest(s) need me.
